recommendation: Keep this source fix. It completes the original non-substantive terminology correction across the current active Questionnaire/QuestionnaireResponse narrative surfaces without broader semantic changes.
issue_request: FHIR-7915 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care issue from the DSTU1 ballot asking that "Research questionnaires/Clinical research forms (CRFs)" be changed to "Research questionnaires and Case report forms (CRFs)" because CRF is a reserved clinical-trial term and the concepts should be split.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in SVN revision 5957, preserved as git commit f2623c9cc216184db0b3edbbf00d0b121eac44b4, but that commit only changed source/questionnaireanswers/questionnaireanswers-introduction.xml. That path later corresponds to the current QuestionnaireResponse page, where the approved wording is already present.
additional_context: The current build also has an active Questionnaire resource, and source/questionnaire/questionnaire-introduction.xml retained the same stale slash wording at the parallel examples list. source/fhir.ini lists Questionnaire as an active resource/status entry, so this narrative is current build source rather than out-of-scope generated output. Jira phrase search found no other Jira issues in the same change family, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/questionnaire/questionnaire-introduction.xml to use the Jira-approved wording, matching current QuestionnaireResponse and removing the misleading slash construction from the active Questionnaire page.
